## 📝 Review Process

1. **Initial Review**: @seapigy/website-owners will review this request
2. **Technical Review**: Technical implementation will be evaluated
3. **Testing Verification**: All testing requirements must be met
4. **Approval**: Authorized approver will apply `website-edit-approved` label
5. **Deployment**: Changes can be merged after approval

**Note**: This request will be automatically closed if not approved within 30 days.
